subject.title: fix: tighten control ui input validation [AI]

question: Should `config.patch` intentionally reject the four legacy accessor method names even though ordinary property assignment does not make them prototype-pollution primitives?
rationale: This trades speculative defense-in-depth against an existing user-config compatibility contract; repository policy requires owner intent rather than an automated merge judgment.

options.title: Preserve accepted names
options.body: Remove the merge-patch-only four-key denylist and land the independently proven Control UI and media hardening.

options.title: Approve the stricter boundary
options.body: Keep the denylist only with explicit config-owner approval plus upgrade tests or operator-visible validation documenting the newly rejected names.

recommendation.title: Preserve accepted names
recommendation.body: Remove the merge-patch-only four-key denylist and land the independently proven Control UI and media hardening.
